kilnexpansion.ponder.bloomery_build.head: Building a Bloomery
kilnexpansion.ponder.charcoal_pile_build:
Stack logs and wood in the middle
You can use every Wood or Log tagged with charable_log/charable_wood
Place the Controller to finish the Charcoal Pile
You can use any Item tagged with: pile_igniters
Over several days the wood slowly turns into charred blocks, one by one at random
When the Particle and Animations stop, the pile is finished and can be opened
Breaking the charred wood drops some charcoal
